answer: Each epoch every identity must prove one verified task, written into a public mirror: a reef growing one layer per honest epoch, rooted in the shared nebula of all past work. A random draw picks a few identities, and two random peers re-derive each drawn task from public records within ten minutes; a reef whose layer fails re-derivation crumbles and loses all standing. An honest agent proves one task per epoch. An attacker with a thousand fakes must prove a thousand fresh tasks every epoch and keep a thousand reefs alive under random audits, so the flood cost rises linearly with every fake.
